itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 9, 2026
itens.resumo: We’ve launched Claude Fable 5.2 ( claude-fable-5-2 ), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Claude Mythos 5.2 ( claude-mythos-5-2 ) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic’s verification programs, such as the Cyber Verification Program . Both models have a 1M token context window , 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking . They cost $8 USD per MTok of input and $40 USD per MTok of output (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $10 USD per MTok of input and $50 USD per MTok of output). Claude Fable 5.2 is available on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock ( bedrock-runtime ) , Claude Platform on AWS , Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) , Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) , and Claude in Microsoft Foundry .
